author: Sebastian Burke
title: Vikings to host Fort Valley State in season-opener - NewsBreak
text:
By Sebastian Burke ,
11 hours ago
Coach Adrian Jones’ Vikings football team will play five games at Roebuck Stadium this season, including an Aug 29 game with Fort Valley State University.
“This schedule reflects our commitment to competitive excellence and meaningful engagement with our alumni and supporters. We are ready to take another step in the right direction in year two.” Jones said.
Elizabeth City State University has announced the Vikings’ 2026 season schedule, which includes five home game and give road dates.
The Vikings open the season Aug. 29 by hosting Fort Valley State (Georgia) during the highly anticipated Legends Weekend, a celebration honoring the legacy of ECSU football.
Following the season opener, ECSU travels west to face N.C. Central University on Sept. 5, before returning home to take on Virginia State University, Sept. 19.
The Vikings will host Bowie State University Sept. 26 in another key conference matchup. Conference play continues with a road contest at Virginia Union University Oct. 3, and continues with Homecoming Oct. 10 against Lincoln University—one of the season’s marquee events.
The Vikings will close out October with road games against Fayetteville State University and Livingstone College, before returning home for Senior Day Oct. 31 versus Winston-Salem State University.
ECSU wraps up the regular season Nov. 7 at Bluefield State University, with aspirations of advancing to the CIAA Championship and the NCAA Division II Playoffs beginning Nov. 21.
Fans are encouraged to mark their calendars and support the Vikings throughout the 2026 campaign.
For more information, visit ecsuvikings.com. Finalized game times and ticketing information for the 2026 season will be released toward the end of May.
